answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vault. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
